initiative.title: Visual Asset Adoption (graph, avatars, fonts, icons, color)
initiative.summary: Adopt the open/permissive, no-build visual resources curated in reviews/RESEARCH-2026-06-20-ui-ux-visual-resources.md into the operator console: deterministic agent avatars, a proper dependency/agent graph, OFL fonts, an inline-SVG icon set, recolorable state illustrations, and accessible data-viz palettes. All assets self-hosted/vendored, permissive-licensed, and landed as experimental per the design-system maturity tiers.

taskset.summary: Implement the research-backed visual upgrade: DiceBear CC0 seeded agent avatars with role accents; Dagre+d3-force graph rendering for dependency/state-machine/live-agent views; Geist OFL fonts; Lucide icons; unDraw state illustrations; Radix+Carbon data-viz palette tokens and sparklines. Permissive-only, no-build, self-hosted, token-driven, landed experimental.

tasks.title: Agent avatar identity system (DiceBear CC0 + role accent)
tasks.goal: Give every agent a deterministic visual identity: a seeded SVG avatar keyed to agent id, plus a deterministic per-role accent, self-hosted and version-pinned.
tasks.scope: Add a pattern_component patternAgentAvatar in ui_design_assets.py (experimental tier). Use DiceBear in seeded mode with a CC0 style (Notionists preferred; Open Peeps/Pixel Art acceptable). Do NOT depend on the live api.dicebear.com at runtime: pre-generate or vendor the style and self-host SVGs; pin the DiceBear major version. Layer a deterministic role accent (ring/background) drawn in our own SVG mapped to existing role/status tokens; verify WCAG contrast in dark and light. Record the exact CC0 style + version in the module docstring.
acceptance: patternAgentAvatar renders a stable SVG avatar for a given agent id (same id -> same avatar) using a CC0 DiceBear style, with no runtime call to api.dicebear.com.
A deterministic per-role accent (ring/background) maps to role/status tokens and meets WCAG AA contrast in both dark and light themes.
The chosen style, its CC0 license, and the pinned DiceBear version are recorded in the asset module; no raw color/size literals (design_system_gate --all-ui passes).
Avatar appears in at least one console view (e.g. agent cards / live agent map) with desktop+mobile visual_verification.

units.title: Vendor + self-host a CC0 DiceBear style and add patternAgentAvatar
units.context: DiceBear is MIT but per-style licensed; Notionists/Open Peeps/Pixel Art are CC0. Determinism + license hold only within a major version, and the free API is rate-limited/non-commercial, so self-host.
units.scope: Vendor/pre-generate a single CC0 style; add a seeded patternAgentAvatar helper returning SVG; no runtime CDN dependency.
steps: Pick a CC0 style (Notionists) and pin the DiceBear major version.
Pre-generate or vendor the style so avatars resolve offline.
Add patternAgentAvatar(seed) -> SVG string in ui_design_assets.py, classified experimental.
Record style+license+version in the module docstring.
Add a determinism test (same seed -> identical SVG).
acceptance: Same agent id yields identical avatar SVG; no api.dicebear.com call at runtime.
units.handoff: Avatar helper ready; unit 2 adds role accent + console placement.
units.stop_condition: If a CC0 style cannot be vendored offline cleanly, stop and flag rather than depending on the live API.

units.title: Deterministic role accent + console placement
units.context: Role must read at a glance without relying on the avatar alone; accent maps to existing role/status tokens and must be WCAG-safe in both themes.
units.scope: Add a deterministic role->accent mapping drawn in our SVG and place the avatar in at least one view.
steps: Map each ORG-MODEL role to an accent token deterministically.
Draw the accent ring/background in our own SVG around the avatar.
Place patternAgentAvatar in agent cards and/or the live agent map.
Verify WCAG AA in dark and light; capture desktop+mobile evidence.
acceptance: Role accent is deterministic, token-driven, WCAG AA in both themes, and visible in a console view.
units.stop_condition: If any accent fails WCAG AA in either theme, adjust the token mapping before closing.

tasks.title: Dependency / state-machine / live-agent graph upgrade (Dagre + d3-force)
tasks.goal: Replace the hand-rolled graph layout with proper layout engines: Dagre (MIT, layered/Sugiyama) for dependency/org/state-machine DAGs and d3-force (ISC) for the free-form live agent map, both vendored build-less and rendered as our own SVG with Datadog/GitHub-style encodings.
tasks.scope: Vendor Dagre and d3-force as build-less <script>/UMD assets served by ui_console_assets.py (no CDN at runtime; record licenses). Feed graph data to the layout engine, then render with the existing/extended SVG pattern helpers (patternSvgGraph / patternSvgLayeredRadialLayout). Encode edges Datadog-style (stroke-width = magnitude, stroke color = health token) and add GitHub-Actions-style per-node status icons. Land as experimental; keep token-driven (no raw literals). Do NOT adopt elkjs (EPL-2.0) or 3d-force-graph (WebGL).
acceptance: Dagre (MIT) and d3-force (ISC) are vendored and served locally (no runtime CDN); each library's license is recorded.
Dependency/state-machine views use a Dagre layered layout rendered as our SVG; the live agent map uses d3-force tick-rendered SVG.
Edges encode magnitude (stroke-width) and health (stroke color token); each node shows a status icon; status is never color-only.
design_system_gate --all-ui passes (token-driven, no raw literals); desktop+mobile visual_verification of at least the dependency graph and live map.

units.title: Vendor Dagre + layered DAG renderer for dependency/state-machine
units.context: Dagre is layout-only (emits node {x,y} + edge point arrays) and ships an IIFE global via <script>. Render with our own SVG; avoid dagre-d3 (pulls in D3).
units.scope: Vendor dagre.min.js locally; add a layered-DAG render path feeding the existing SVG graph pattern; Datadog edge + GitHub status encodings.
steps: Vendor dagre.min.js (MIT) into served assets; record license.
Compute a top-down/L-R layered layout; map coordinates onto our SVG nodes/edges.
Encode edge stroke-width=magnitude, stroke color=health token; add per-node status icon (from the icon set).
Apply to the dependency graph and state-machine views.
acceptance: Dependency/state-machine graph uses Dagre layout rendered as our token-driven SVG with status-bearing nodes/edges.
units.handoff: Structured graph done; unit 2 does the force map.
units.stop_condition: If Dagre cannot be vendored build-less, stop and flag (do not fall back to elkjs/EPL-2.0).

units.title: Vendor d3-force + live agent map renderer
units.context: d3-force is a velocity-Verlet layout that mutates node.x/.y and fires tick; we render SVG per tick. Confirm ISC license + a standalone UMD artifact.
units.scope: Vendor d3-force build-less; tick-render the live agent map as our SVG with agent avatars as nodes.
steps: Confirm d3-force ISC license + vendor a standalone UMD build (no CDN).
Wire tick-driven SVG rendering of the live agent map.
Use patternAgentAvatar nodes + health-encoded edges.
Verify interactivity (drag/zoom optional) and dark/light.
acceptance: Live agent map renders via d3-force as token-driven SVG with avatar nodes; license recorded.
units.stop_condition: If a build-less ISC d3-force artifact cannot be confirmed, flag before vendoring.

tasks.title: Typography + icon foundation (Geist OFL fonts + Lucide icons)
tasks.goal: Self-host OFL fonts (Geist + Geist Mono) as font tokens and vendor the Lucide (ISC) inline-SVG icon set behind a componentIcon helper.
tasks.scope: Add self-hosted woff2 Geist + Geist Mono with @font-face wired to typography tokens (no Google/CDN at runtime; record OFL). Vendor Lucide SVGs (ISC) and add a componentIcon(name) helper returning inline SVG that inherits currentColor/tokens. Land as experimental; classify per assetization rules. Confirm OFL/ISC terms before committing the binaries.
acceptance: Geist + Geist Mono are self-hosted (woff2) and bound to typography tokens; no runtime font CDN; OFL recorded.
Lucide icons are vendored (ISC, recorded) and exposed via componentIcon returning inline SVG that inherits token color.
design_system_gate --all-ui passes; a representative screen shows the new fonts + icons with desktop+mobile evidence.

units.title: Self-host Geist + Geist Mono as font tokens
units.context: Geist/Geist Mono are OFL 1.1, built for dev tools, matching the stated direction. Self-host variable woff2; no CDN.
units.scope: Add @font-face for self-hosted woff2 + wire to type tokens.
steps: Vendor Geist + Geist Mono woff2 (confirm OFL); record license.
Add @font-face and bind font-family tokens.
Verify rendering + fallback stack.
acceptance: Console uses self-hosted Geist/Geist Mono via tokens; no font CDN; OFL recorded.
units.stop_condition: If OFL terms or a self-host artifact are unclear, flag before committing binaries.

units.title: Vendor Lucide icon set + componentIcon helper
units.context: Lucide is ISC, clean stroke icons matching the Linear/Notion look; use as inline SVG inheriting currentColor.
inputs: the existing icon usages / entity glyphs
units.scope: Vendor the needed Lucide SVGs (ISC) + componentIcon(name) returning token-colored inline SVG.
steps: Vendor the icon subset actually used (ISC); record license.
Add componentIcon(name) -> inline SVG inheriting currentColor.
Replace ad-hoc glyphs/entities (e.g. ☰) with componentIcon where sensible.
acceptance: Icons render via componentIcon as token-colored inline SVG; Lucide ISC license recorded.
units.stop_condition: Keep scope to vendored subset; do not pull a build-required icon package.

tasks.title: State illustrations + data-viz palette + sparklines
tasks.goal: Add recolorable empty/error/loading illustrations, accessible data-viz palette tokens, and inline sparklines for at-a-glance trends.
tasks.scope: Vendor recolorable unDraw illustrations (recolor to accent token) wired into EmptyState/ErrorState/Loading patterns. Add categorical+sequential data-viz palette tokens from Radix Colors (MIT) + IBM Carbon data-viz (Apache), with dark+light + WCAG, for graph/chart use. Vendor fnando/sparkline (MIT) as componentSparkline. All permissive, self-hosted, token-driven, experimental.
acceptance: Empty/Error/Loading states use recolorable unDraw illustrations tinted to the accent token (license recorded).
Categorical + sequential data-viz palette tokens (Radix/Carbon) exist for both themes with WCAG-adequate contrast, consumed by the graph/charts.
componentSparkline (fnando/sparkline, MIT) renders inline SVG trends; license recorded.
design_system_gate --all-ui passes; desktop+mobile visual_verification of a state screen + a sparkline.

units.title: Recolorable unDraw state illustrations
units.context: unDraw is single-accent recolorable with no attribution; tint to the console accent for instant on-brand empty/error/loading.
units.scope: Vendor a few unDraw SVGs, recolor to accent token, wire into state patterns.
steps: Vendor relevant unDraw SVGs; record license.
Tint via accent token (currentColor/CSS var).
Wire into componentEmptyState + error/loading patterns.
acceptance: State screens show accent-tinted unDraw art; no raw color literals.
units.handoff: State art done; unit 2 does palette + sparkline.
units.stop_condition: Confirm unDraw license terms before committing assets.

units.title: Data-viz palette tokens + componentSparkline
units.context: Graphs need accessible categorical/sequential palettes (Radix MIT / Carbon Apache) in both themes; sparklines give at-a-glance trends via fnando/sparkline (MIT).
units.scope: Add data-viz palette tokens + vendor sparkline + componentSparkline helper.
steps: Add categorical + sequential data-viz tokens (dark+light, WCAG) from Radix/Carbon; record licenses.
Point the graph node/edge colors at the categorical tokens.
Vendor fnando/sparkline (MIT); add componentSparkline(data) -> inline SVG.
Use a sparkline in a metric view (agent load / gate pass-rate).
acceptance: Graph uses token palettes; componentSparkline renders inline; licenses recorded; gate green.
units.stop_condition: Keep palettes token-driven; never inline raw hex outside the token layer.
